data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool failure in the qwen model, which encountered an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD and .gitignore files, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .gitignore due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400).
learnings: API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) during file review should be explicitly categorized as tool/coverage failures rather than contributing to an 'inconclusive' security verdict.
Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient or malformed API requests to prevent partial audits from skewing the final package verdict.
